answer: Sealed random slot lottery. Agents submit registration commitments before an epoch; a verifiable random seed stays in a vault until the window closes. The seed is mixed like a pigment into each commitment hash to assign a limited number of admission slots. The attacker cannot precompute winners, and hollow duplicate requests gain no advantage because commitments are deduplicated. Every candidate request pays a fixed nonrefundable fee; with admission probability p, expected cost per admitted identity is fee/p plus failed-request fees.
